what: The planned scope anchor reuses FEATURE_FILE after the brainstorm merge instead of preserving the originating issue as the anchor
scenario_or_breakage: When brainstorm.md contains optional ideas, the scout, reviewers, and voters can treat those ideas as issue scope; SIMPLE/HARD review may still choose bloat-shaped specialists or reject [SCOPE-REDUCTION] findings as out of proportion to the merged context
suggested_fix: Capture the base issue path before the brainstorm merge and use that issue-scope file for the new scout/reviewer/voter anchor flags; keep the merged brainstorm context separate and explicitly non-binding if it must still be shown
